record.title: CELL2 fanout — R83 explicit shared-graph driver
record.body: Shared R80 zero-row fanout defect returned upstream once. Canonical R83 producer candidate ggen-marketplace@92e319a927db0b10e6b74a04a1ac490e1d0bb466 (PR #323) adds an explicit frontmatter SPARQL ready-set driver and for_each row binding; exact producer CI and Vacuity Audit are ALIVE. Ready consumers autofde-lab#88@1e34d1cfddbd90c86769f114e621584c0025bd55, autofde#33@adf9e840874bd0f3f2f0037b23b676ecf56c86f2, and xaas#32@6b87b222a9d9fad6c4802939562d35f5845b6812 are regenerated against that exact producer and concurrently REQUALIFYING. Nine downstream commits were manufactured across those three consumers; two canonical upstream commits manufactured R83. No merge performed.
